title: Durable convergence permit consumption and replay protection
supported_claim: On the tested SQLite WAL-backed platform authority path, permit semantic bindings and one-time consumption survive authority restart. Exact unconsumed permits remain live once; consumed permits remain denied after restart and repeated restart; same-nonce semantic rebinding, forgery, case/class/scope/verifier/signal substitution, stale epochs, and concurrent double consumption fail closed. A clean fresh permit remains live exactly once after the tested attack vectors.
storage_integrity_boundary: The pilot does not establish tamper resistance of the SQLite store. Direct deletion of a consumed record was explicitly tested only for fail-closed behavior on later consumption; no claim is made that deletion or coherent rollback can be detected independently from the local store itself.
not_proven: Tamper-evident or tamper-resistant persistence under coherent local database rewrite or rollback
next_falsification_target: EXP-I Pilot 4: externally anchored integrity for the durable convergence-permit ledger, including coherent rollback, deletion, status resurrection, epoch lowering, and payload rebinding attempts.
